name: crosslg-cont-tg-benchmark-grade
description: A Hugging Face-hosted benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual content grading and target-language quality assessment. It is designed to measure how well models can assess or grade content (e.g., translations, answers, or generated text) across languages and grading rubrics. The suite emphasizes consistency between source and target language content and the model's ability to assign coherent grades or quality scores.
evaluation_method: accuracy/F1 for categorical grades and correlation/MAE for continuous/rating-style scores (task-dependent)
general_score_metric: accuracy or correlation depending on task (categorical vs. continuous grading)
reputation: A niche dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for cross-lingual grading and content-quality experiments.
